total_supply_zero.meaning: gauge _totalSupply equals zero after all staked tokens are withdrawn
total_supply_zero.checkpoint: before reward accrual during the empty period

empty_period_elapsed.meaning: time passes with zero total supply and no deposits
empty_period_elapsed.checkpoint: before reward accrual during the empty period

notify_reward_called.meaning: distribution contract calls notifyRewardAmount to add new rewards during the empty period

empty_period_rewards_accrued.meaning: rewards emitted during the zero-supply period are accrued and remain claimable rather than skipped when lastUpdateTime advances
empty_period_rewards_accrued.checkpoint: after reward accrual for the empty period

protocol_fund_loss.meaning: entire epochs of reward emissions become permanently stuck in the contract, causing unrecoverable protocol fund loss

claims.scope: GaugeV2 reward accrual and distribution when total staked supply is zero

preconditions.text: Users withdraw or withdrawAll all staked tokens from the gauge, setting _totalSupply to zero.; Time passes without any deposits while total supply is zero.; During the empty period, notifyRewardAmount may be called by the distribution contract to add new rewards.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Rewards emitted during a period, including periods of zero total supply, should be accrued and remain claimable rather than being skipped when lastUpdateTime advances.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Entire epochs of reward emissions can become permanently stuck, leading to protocol fund loss without recovery, with higher impact in low-liquidity gauges that frequently empty.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: Skipped emissions cannot be recovered by any later notifyRewardAmount or interaction (as_no_recovery).
The distribution contract is the actor that may call notifyRewardAmount during the empty period.
The empty period spans at least one full reward duration (one week) for the stuck-epoch scenario.

limitations: The claim formalizes only i_protocol_fund_loss; i_unclaimable_rewards and i_full_epoch_stuck are separate impacts not covered here.
Accrual and loss are represented as grounded Boolean observables because the report gives no numeric emission or accrual formula.
The condition encodes the general zero-supply empty-period scenario rather than a specific attacker/victim configuration.
